description:
About the Scholarship

The UNIL Master's Scholarship is offered by the University of Lausanne (UNIL), Switzerland, to approximately 10 foreign university graduates each year. It provides CHF 1,600 per month from 15 September to 15 July (approximately 10 months per year). This is not a full funding scholarship. Living costs in Lausanne are approximately CHF 2,000 per month.

Financial Coverage

  • CHF 1,600 per month (15 September to 15 July).
  • Course registration fee exempt; only CHF 80 per semester payable.
  • Accommodation guaranteed at FMEL (Student Housing Foundation Lausanne). Rent is paid by the student but is below market rate.
  • Withdrawal from Master's programme results in scholarship suspension.

Eligibility and Requirements

  • Foreign university degree (Swiss bachelor equivalent, 180 ECTS). Degree must be from outside Switzerland.
  • Must not have been previously enrolled at UNIL.
  • Outstanding academic results.
  • Language C1 level in French (for French-taught programmes) or English (for English-taught programmes).
  • CHF 200 administrative fee (non-refundable).

Excluded Programmes

  • School of Medicine.
  • Sciences and Practices of Education.
  • Master of Law (exceptions: International and Comparative Law, Legal Theory, International Tax Law and Policy).
  • MSc Physical Education and Sport Didactics.
  • MSc Health Sciences.
  • MSc Sustainable Management and Technology.
  • MSc Human Taphonomy.
  • All MAS programmes.
  • Extra conditions apply for Finance, Psychology, Arts, and Nursing.

About University of Lausanne

The University of Lausanne is a public research university in Switzerland, located near Lake Geneva. UNIL offers undergraduate, master's and doctoral programmes across medicine, life sciences, law, business, humanities and social sciences. Its academic work supports research across disciplines, connecting education with questions in health, society, culture and the environment.

Official website: https://www.unil.ch

Application dates

MilestoneDate
Application deadline1 November 2026
ProcessingNovember-December 2026
Faculty reviewJanuary-February 2027
Selection BoardMarch 2027
DecisionEarly April 2027

Application Process

  1. Complete online application with single PDF upload: CV with photo, cover letter (1-2 pages), diploma and transcripts (authenticated translation if not FR/DE/EN/IT), language certificate, high school diploma, passport copy, CHF 200 payment proof.
  2. Two recommendation letters sent directly by authors from professional email to mastergrants@unil.ch by 1 November.
  3. If country is not in Lisbon Convention, certified true copies must be sent by post.
  4. Scholarship application serves as Master's admission application. No separate admission application required.

Contact

  • Email: mastergrants@unil.ch

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be sent to the contacts above or raised through the channel given on the official announcement page.

Official Link

https://www.unil.ch/unil/en/home/menuinst/etudier/mobilite-et-echange/etudiantes-et-etudiants-internationaux/etudiantes-internationaux-reguliers/bourse-de-master.html

Important Notes

  • Not full funding. Additional personal resources required.
  • No appeal allowed after decision.

How to Apply

Submit your application through the official portal before the deadline: 1 November 2026. Read the eligibility requirements carefully and prepare all requested documents — early applications are strongly recommended for competitive awards.

Open the official application page ↗

Application guides

  • How to Ask for a Recommendation Letter: Emails and Preparation
